import type { TutorialPanelContract, TutorialStopDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { SurfaceController } from '../../controllers/surface-controller.js';
export declare class TutorialPanel extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        open: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        tasks: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        activeTaskId: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        activeStepId: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        running: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultRunning: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        activePanel: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        defaultActivePanel: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        startActionId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        fallbackFocusId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        narrow: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        coordinatedStop: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
    };
    open: boolean | undefined;
    defaultOpen: boolean | undefined;
    tasks: TutorialPanelContract['tasks'];
    activeTaskId: string | null;
    activeStepId: string | null;
    running: boolean | undefined;
    defaultRunning: boolean | undefined;
    activePanel: 'help' | 'tutorial' | undefined;
    defaultActivePanel: 'help' | 'tutorial' | undefined;
    startActionId: string;
    fallbackFocusId: string;
    private narrow;
    coordinatedStop: boolean;
    private openState;
    private runningState;
    private panelState;
    private media?;
    private observer?;
    private stopPending;
    private exposurePending;
    private observedTarget;
    private pendingStart;
    readonly surface: SurfaceController;
    constructor();
    get committedOpen(): boolean;
    get committedRunning(): boolean;
    get committedPanel(): "tutorial" | "help";
    private resize;
    private route;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    private stopDetails;
    private show;
    private selectPanel;
    start(taskId?: string | undefined, stepId?: string): void;
    stop(reason?: TutorialStopDetails['reason']): void;
    updated(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
